description: This file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM project, specifically implementing database schema updates related to internationalization (i18n) data structures and menu configuration for version 4.6.0. It includes methods to create tables, define foreign keys and unique constraints, insert language and group data from YAML files, and modify menu items in the admin interface.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Defines database schema changes and initial data insertion for internationalization and menu configuration for OrangeHRM version 4.6.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs schema creation, constraints setup, data insertion, and menu configuration modifications.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version identifier of the migration, '4.6'.

methods.name: readlanguageYaml
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML file containing language or group data and returns the first element of the parsed array.

methods.name: insertLanguages
methods.description: Inserts language records into the 'ohrm_i18n_language' table from an array of language data.

methods.name: insertGroups
methods.description: Inserts group records into the 'ohrm_i18n_group' table from an array of group data.
